# Shortlist comparison

Cobble Row offers a shorter commute, while Larkspur Lane has the lower rent and a stated deposit. Alex has not chosen a flat; the missing Cobble Row deposit prevents a complete comparison of upfront costs.

| Flat | Rent | Commute | Deposit | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [[Larkspur Lane flat]] | 1,450 a month | 24 min | 1,450 | viewing done |
| [[Cobble Row flat]] | 1,580 a month | 18 min | Not stated | viewing booked |

## Trade-offs

If commute matters most, Cobble Row deserves a viewing. If lower rent and known upfront costs matter more, Larkspur Lane is easier to assess now. Ask for the Cobble Row deposit before deciding; missing information is not a zero deposit. No affordability claim follows without Alex's budget.

## Sources

- [[Shortlist briefing.txt]]: the shortlist facts as of 2026-10-10.
- [[Larkspur Lane flat]]: rent, commute, deposit and viewing status.
- [[Cobble Row flat]]: rent, commute, missing deposit and viewing status.
- [[Flat hunt]]: Alex's commute preference and undecided status.
